layout: Every board shares one outline: a hexagonal hull module (circumradius 180, centre 0,0). Side 4 (top) is the Outer Hull; sides 0-3 and 5 are docking sides with a point-symmetric tab/slot profile, so any docking side mates with any other. `layouts` place boards on a hex grid ([x, y, rotation in degrees]) with each Hull facing the void; `links` join sections across docked sides.
setup_rule: Per board: 1 Failure, 2 Faults and 1 Glitch, each in a different section type (rotated between boards), 1 Decay next to the Failure, 6 Crew (2,2,1,1) across 4 sections away from the Failure and Decay.
